title: 第13章 你就是我亲哥第14章 燕文冕
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
唐长老看向执法堂门口的方向，朝着执法堂小队队员喊道：“葛颜擅闯执法堂，现在把他带进去交由审讯司审讯，酌情定罪，再交由行刑司进行处罚。”
“是！”小虎立马带人过来，将地上的葛颜架起来带走。
葛颜一脸错愕，执法堂的人真敢动他？
而刚才，曹立是真的想斩他？疯了吧执法堂？
葛颜嚣张跋扈的脑子有点宕机，但旋即，是一种羞恼，然后……就是后怕。
若刚刚不是唐长老出手，小命休矣~~
葛颜立马被小虎等人抬进了执法堂。
唐长老松了一口气，小曹没有其他的动作就好。
唐长老朝曹立走去：“小曹啊，对这个结果，可还满意？”
“胆敢闯我执法堂，自然不能让他这么轻易离去，不付出点代价，谁都效仿他怎么办，我执法堂威严何在？”曹立将戒尺收起。
唐长老脸抽了抽……
小曹似乎变了~~
难不成是长老这个职位的使命感？激发了小曹内心的正义感？那还真不如当个小队长好啊~
唐长老努力的挤出笑容：“小曹你有这种觉悟，我们这种长辈很开心啊。”
“唐长老放心，执法堂交给我，一定不会让你们失望的。”说完，曹立看向那几个内门弟子。
唐长老的笑容有点僵~
完了，以后莫不是无法摸鱼了~
老夫的岁月静好，要一去不复返了？
那几个内门弟子，被曹立看过来，全部吓了一跳。
曹立大喊。“来人，把这几个人抓去审讯司问罪。”

“是！”
“曹立，你……”他们想放狠话威胁曹立，可是看到那冷漠的眼神，到喉咙的话，硬生生吞回去。
其他小队成员，上来将几个内门弟子押进去。
“小曹啊，你辛苦了，其实当了长老之后，不用那么辛苦的，很多事情，交给下面的人去做就行了。”唐金春觉得，还是得尽力挽救一下。
曹立突然皱眉，审视的眼神看了看老头子。
老头子被看得心里头咯噔一声，有点小慌。
“唐长老，这种话请恕我不认同，身居高位，更应该体恤底层修士的苦楚，这种事情，更应该亲力亲为。”
“老话说得好，能力越大，责任越大，宗门信任我，我自然要努力做好分内的事情，还凌阳宗一个海晏河清，唐长老，你说是不是？”
唐金春的话被堵回来，他只能尴尬地笑了笑：“肯定是的，能力越大，责任越大嘛！”
曹立这才点头：“唐长老，偷懒的话休要再说，也不用试探我，我曹立忠于职位，可不是那样的人。”
说完，曹立带着大义凛然离开。
剩下唐长老在原地吹着风，表情木然。
小曹难不成是觉得我在试探他，才说得如此滴水不漏？
一时间，唐长老有点看不懂曹立，这小子一贯都是很滑头的呀。
唐长老挠了挠头，到底是哪里出问题了？
曹立昂首挺胸，在所有执法堂队长和队员崇拜的目光中，走进执法堂，朝自己的办公房走去。
关上门，曹立这才松了口气，然后连忙去到自己座位上。
“系统，奖励呢？”
曹立的任务仅仅只是将葛颜抓到执法堂就好了，审讯行刑这种，不关他的事情。
“叮，现在系统为宿主发放奖励：结丹初期修为。”
content_en:
Elder Tang looked in the direction of the door of the Law Enforcement Hall and shouted to the members of the Law Enforcement Hall team: "Ge Yan broke into the Law Enforcement Hall without permission. Now bring him in and hand him over to the Interrogation Department for interrogation. He will be convicted as appropriate and then handed over to the Execution Department for punishment."
"Yes!" Xiaohu immediately brought someone over, picked up Ge Yan on the ground and took him away.
Ge Yan looked stunned. People from the Law Enforcement Hall really dared to touch him?
And just now, did Cao Li really want to kill him? Are you crazy? Law Enforcement Hall?
Ge Yan's arrogant and domineering mind was a little shut down, but immediately, there was a sense of shame and annoyance, and then... fear.
If Elder Tang hadn't taken action just now, his life would have been over~~
Ge Yan was immediately carried into the law enforcement hall by Xiaohu and others.
Elder Tang breathed a sigh of relief, as long as Xiao Cao didn't make any other moves.
Elder Tang walked towards Cao Li: "Xiao Cao, are you satisfied with this result?"
"He dares to break into our law enforcement hall. Naturally, we can't let him leave so easily. What if everyone follows his example without paying a price? Where is the majesty of our law enforcement hall?" Cao Li put away the ruler.
Elder Tang's face twitched...
Xiao Cao seems to have changed~~
Could it be that the position of elder has a sense of mission? Did it inspire Xiao Cao's inner sense of justice? It's really better to be a squad leader~
Elder Tang tried his best to smile: "Xiao Cao, you have this kind of awareness. Elders like us are very happy."
"Don't worry, Elder Tang. If you leave the Law Enforcement Hall to me, you will not be disappointed." After saying that, Cao Li looked at the inner disciples.
Elder Tang’s smile was a little stiff~
It’s over, maybe I won’t be able to fish anymore~
My peaceful years are going to be gone forever?
The inner disciples were all startled when Cao Li looked over.
Cao Li shouted. "Come here, arrest these people and take them to the interrogation department for questioning."
"Yes!"
"Cao Li, you..." They wanted to threaten Cao Li with harsh words, but when they saw the cold eyes, the words reached their throats and they swallowed them back.
Other team members came up and escorted several inner disciples inside.
"Xiao Cao, you have worked hard. In fact, after becoming an elder, you don't have to work so hard. Many things can be left to the people below." Tang Jinchun felt that he still had to try his best to save it.
Cao Li suddenly frowned and looked at the old man with a scrutinizing look.
The old man's heart thumped when he saw it, and he panicked a little.
"Elder Tang, please forgive me for not agreeing with this statement. As a high-ranking person, you should be more considerate of the sufferings of the monks at the bottom. This kind of thing should be done personally."
"As the old saying goes, the greater the ability, the greater the responsibility. If the sect trusts me, I will naturally work hard to do my job well and return Lingyang Sect to Haiyanheqing. Elder Tang, don't you think so?"
Tang Jinchun's words were blocked, and he could only smile awkwardly: "It must be true. The greater the ability, the greater the responsibility!"
Cao Li then nodded: "Elder Tang, don't say anything about laziness, and there is no need to test me. I, Cao Li, am loyal to my position, and I am not that kind of person."
After speaking, Cao Li left with great justice.
Elder Tang was left blowing in the wind with a dull expression.
Could it be that Xiao Cao thought I was testing him, so he spoke so accurately?
For a moment, Elder Tang couldn't understand Cao Li. This guy has always been very cunning.
Elder Tang scratched his head. What went wrong?
With his head held high, Cao Li walked into the law enforcement hall and walked towards his office under the admiring eyes of all the captains and team members of the law enforcement hall.
After closing the door, Cao Li breathed a sigh of relief and quickly went to his seat.
"System, where are the rewards?"
Cao Li's mission was just to capture Ge Yan and take him to the law enforcement hall. Interrogation and execution were none of his business.
"Ding, now the system will issue a reward to the host: the initial cultivation level of pill formation."
